Project 4s

Say Hello, to the iPhone 4s:

iPhone 4s's Announcement and Release

The iPhone 4s was announced on October 4th, 2011 and was released 10 days later.

It was the last iPhone to have Steve Jobs as its CEO and the first to have Tim Cook as its CEO later on in development.

It was extremely cheap at the time. 199$ for 16GB, 299$ for 32GB and 399$ for 64GB! Thats 2 times cheaper than the base iPhone 17!

iPhone 4s's Camera

It was the first iPhone to have a 8MP Backside Camera that can record 1080p at 30fps.

It also had a 1.2 MP Frontside Camera that could record at 720p, 30fps.

It was the first iPhone with the front facing camera.

iPhone 4s's Software

it was the first iPhone ever to have AI, known as Siri.

It Supported iOS 5 to iOS 9.3.1 and it was the first iPhone to support iOS 7, the boring flat design update

iPhone 4s's Back

It has a sleek glass back design, which then the iPhone 5 made the back aluminum.

iPhone 4s's Side, Top and Bottom

It was the first iPhone to have a antenna signal bar outside of the phone, which on the iPhone 4 was a design flaw, so they fixed it on the iPhone 4s.

It supported HSUPA 4G and HSDPA 4G.

It was the last iPhone to have the famous 30-pin connector, which was then replaced by the lightning cable on the next iPhone, the iPhone 5.

It also was the first iPhone to have the circular volume buttons, which are very nice and smooth.

iPhone 4s's Front

it was the first iPhone to have that sweet retina display with a 3.5 inch screen and a 960x640 screen resolution.

It was the last iPhone to have that old home button design, which for me was a masterpiece of old school design.

iPhone 4s's Hardware

It has a A5 which was a dual core processor with 1GHz.

It also has 512mb of DDR2 RAM and a 1430 mAh Li-Ion Battery.
